reviews.author: Mae Tilton
reviews.text: Highly recommend! Justin did an awesome job getting us out of a tight spot. Professional, polite and timely. Overall great experience!

reviews.author: Staley Brown
reviews.text: JusTows is amazing. Open 24hrs, super responsive, incredibly well priced, and really cares about taking care of your property. I had a car break down and was able to simply drop a location pin and head home. Car showed up about an hour later. I was going to have it dropped in my second drive but the driver noticed some small tree branches that may scratch the hood of the car. It was 32 degrees, pitch dark, and late in the evening. The car was a 2011 Hyundai and I was telling him where to put it. The point is time is money, instead of just doing it my way, the gentlemen suggested a different method that took a little longer but protected my old trash whip. The world needs more drivers like this. Imma sharpie this dude's phone number in all my glove boxes. You should too.

reviews.author: Landon Sheedy
